mapper.select: select h.tag as hashtag, count(*) as count from users as u left join review as r on u.user_id = r.user_id left join musical as m on r.musical_id = m.musical_id left join tag_connection as t on t.musical_id = m.musical_id left join hashtag as h on h.tag_id = t.tag_id where u.user_id = #{id} and r.rate >= 3 group by h.tag limit 3;
